card.name: Inside brand drug names and Child-Pugh
card.fires_on: The early piece of a capitalized brand drug name such as TECENTRIQ, XOLAIR, AUGTYRO or TRINTELLIX, and the "-P" in Child-Pugh. It fires in label text where the name is repeated.

modes.label: Brand name pieces
modes.description: An early piece of an all-caps brand name, just before the rest of the name is completed.
modes.example: withholding of T<<EC>>ENTRIQ in one patient

modes.label: Child-Pugh class
modes.description: The "-P" in Child-Pugh, written before a hepatic impairment class.

card.plain: It fires partway through a capitalized brand drug name, or in Child-Pugh, where the rest of the term is already predictable.
